crossRefs.note: As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?”
In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped…

people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Zimri
people.line: King of Israel, reigned seven days

translations.web: and Zimri went in and struck him, and killed him, in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: So in the twenty-seventh year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Zimri went in, struck Elah down, and killed him. And Zimri reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: and Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
